01.Description: {Data.name} does not have materials because it is an empty, lattice, light source, armature etc.

03.Description: You've tried to fix world that isn't a world, perhaps you should try Fix Materials instead

04.Description: This .blend file was made with an older verion of MiBlend. {Data}. Some features may not work correctly.

05.Name: This is an MiEx world
